verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Thoropass integrates audit workflow into its platform (listing audits, evidence requests, auditor acceptance) and ties pentesting/compliance findings directly into audit reporting, implying an auditor relationship exists, but nothing describes a bookable audit service, a vetted auditor network, an in-house audit arm, or published timeline commitments. missing for 10: explicit booking/scheduling mechanism for an audit, description of auditor network or in-house audit arm, published timeline expectations.
